acceptanceCriteria: A merged main run shows the record job succeeding and docs-plan deciding REUSE from it on an unchanged tree
A run whose shard artifact is forged or missing decides FULL
A rerun of ci-control-plane after an owner post keeps success, and a new push gets failure
body: Lane ci-tools-1021i (PR #1455, folded into #1449, V1-2271) moved docs-plan reuse trust to a new ci-tested-tree-record job whose log is read through the jobs API. Only local workflow tests ran it. NOT_RUN: a hosted record job, a hosted REUSE decision, and a hosted ci-control-plane rerun that keeps an owner-posted success (AFP-V0-171). Queue entries built by the old tool run the full suite instead of reusing.
title: ci: qualify the ci-tested-tree-record job and the REUSE decision on the first merged hosted runs (AFP-V0-170)
